description: ANKAA-ENGINE ankaad overview: ingest, feed health, latency (software clock), WAL, storage, Flight queries. Metric semantics: docs/metrics-semantics.md.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: ankaa_uptime_seconds: seconds since serve started.

panels.title: Rows in tables
panels.description: ankaa_rows: accepted rows across trades, book_deltas and quotes (updated every snapshot tick).

panels.title: Frames/s
panels.description: rate(ankaa_frames_total): WebSocket, control and snapshot frames entering the ingest loop.

panels.title: Events/s
panels.description: rate(ankaa_events_total): trades + book deltas + snapshots decoded.

panels.title: Dropped rows (1h)
panels.description: increase(ankaa_dropped_rows_total[1h]): rows rejected by appenders (out of order / invalid). Expected 0.

panels.title: Bad frames (1h)
panels.description: increase(ankaa_frames_bad_total[1h]): frames the decoder rejected. Expected 0.

panels.title: Frames and events per second
panels.description: Counters: ankaa_frames_total, ankaa_events_total, ankaa_frames_ignored_total. Events exceed frames because a depth frame carries several levels.

panels.title: Trades vs book deltas per second
panels.description: Decoder statistics copied every snapshot tick (storage.snapshot_ms), so they move in steps.

panels.title: Drops and rejects per second
panels.description: All four should sit at zero.

panels.title: Depth gaps (1h)
panels.description: increase(ankaa_feed_gaps_total[1h]): U != previous u + 1 on the diff stream.

panels.title: Book resyncs (1h)
panels.description: increase(ankaa_book_resyncs_total[1h]): snapshot requests after a gap or a stale snapshot.

panels.title: Connects (24h)
panels.description: increase(ankaa_source_connects_total[24h]): 1 plus reconnects.

panels.title: Snapshots fetched (24h)
panels.description: increase(ankaa_book_snapshots_fetched_total[24h]): REST depth snapshots.

panels.title: Source channel drops
panels.description: ankaa_source_dropped_full_total: frames dropped at the 65,536-frame source channel.

panels.title: Recovered from WAL
panels.description: ankaa_wal_recovered_frames: frames replayed at the last start.

panels.title: Gaps and resyncs per minute
panels.description: A gap is normally followed by exactly one resync for the affected symbol.

panels.title: Connects and snapshot fetches per minute
panels.description: Every connect refetches a snapshot for each depth symbol (rate-limited to one per symbol per 2 s).

panels.title: Channel drops and bad frames per minute
panels.description: Drops are data loss; bad frames are decoder rejections; ignored frames are acks and unknown types (harmless).

panels.title: Ingest latency quantiles (lifetime since start)
panels.description: ankaa_ingest_latency_ns summary: receive-to-watermark per exchange message, 10 us buckets up to 1 s, cumulative since process start (not windowed). Values in the overflow bucket render as u64::MAX and are filtered out here (< 1e9). After a WAL recovery the histogram is polluted by old frames until live samples dominate.

panels.title: Ingest latency: recent mean and last sample
panels.description: rate(_sum)/rate(_count) is the windowed signal; ankaa_last_ingest_latency_ns is the most recent sample (gauge).

panels.title: Flight DoGet wall time
panels.description: Server-side wall time from DoGet request to stream drop; includes how fast the client consumes.

panels.title: Durable LSN
panels.description: ankaa_wal_durable_lsn: highest LSN fdatasync'ed. 0 when the WAL is disabled or empty.

panels.title: Pending bytes
panels.description: ankaa_wal_pending_bytes: appended, not yet committed. Commits at 256 KiB or every 10 ms.

panels.title: Commits/s
panels.description: rate(ankaa_wal_commits_total): group commits (write + fdatasync).

panels.title: WAL errors (1h)
panels.description: increase(ankaa_wal_errors_total[1h]): failed append or commit.

panels.title: WAL refused frames (1h)
panels.description: increase(ankaa_wal_dropped_total[1h]): frames the log did not accept in time (dropped, not ingested).

panels.title: Segments truncated
panels.description: ankaa_wal_truncated_segments_total: planned (no checkpoint policy yet); stays 0.

panels.title: Durable LSN advance per second
panels.description: rate(ankaa_wal_durable_lsn) is one per frame when the WAL keeps up; compare with frames/s.

panels.title: Pending bytes
panels.description: Sawtooth below ~300 KiB is normal. A rising line with a flat LSN means fdatasync is stalled.

panels.title: Commits, errors and drops per second
panels.description: ankaa_wal_commits_total, ankaa_wal_errors_total, ankaa_wal_dropped_total.

panels.title: Rows and sealed chunks
panels.description: ankaa_rows and ankaa_sealed_chunks (gauges, copied every snapshot tick). A chunk seals at 65,536 rows.

panels.title: Tier chunks (stacked)
panels.description: ankaa_tier_chunks{tier}: planned; the gauges render 0 until the tiering step sets them.

panels.title: Tier bytes (stacked)
panels.description: ankaa_tier_bytes{tier}: planned; encoded size for warm and cold.

panels.title: Tier moves, checkpoints and query snapshots per second
panels.description: Tier moves and checkpoints are planned (0 today). Query snapshot swaps should run at 1000/snapshot_ms per second (4/s by default); less means the ingest loop is starved.

panels.title: Statements/s
panels.description: rate(ankaa_queries_total): one per GetFlightInfo, GetSchema and DoGet.

panels.title: Errors (1h)
panels.description: increase(ankaa_query_errors_total[1h]): rejected or failed statements.

panels.title: Unauthenticated (1h)
panels.description: increase(ankaa_query_unauthenticated_total[1h]): Flight calls with a bad token.

panels.title: Rows streamed/s
panels.description: rate(ankaa_query_rows_total).

panels.title: DoGet streams (1h)
panels.description: increase(ankaa_query_do_get_total[1h]).

panels.title: Last DoGet
panels.description: ankaa_query_last_do_get_ns.

panels.title: Statements and errors per second
panels.description: ankaa_queries_total, ankaa_query_errors_total, ankaa_query_do_get_total.

panels.title: Unauthenticated calls per minute
panels.description: ankaa_query_unauthenticated_total: expected 0 on a closed network.

panels.title: Rows streamed per second
panels.description: ankaa_query_rows_total: rows in record batches sent to clients.
